description: Even everyday items should bring enjoyment to your daily routine. With this modern and sleek soap dispenser from Umbra, refilling it is super simple, and using it is a pleasure. Introducing the Touch Soap Pump by Umbra Touch Soap Pump is made of a matte, soft-touch molded material, which is easy to clean, and highly durable. The finish is delicate, smooth to the touch, and pleasing to the eye. Its curved pump is a departure from the typical soap pump, fitting the curve of your hand and dispensing soap with ease. Easy to refill, simply twist off the clear container at the bottom of the dispenser to refill your soap. Its wide opening makes pouring soap inside easy and spill-free. It's easy to tell when soap levels are low thanks to the clear soap chamber at the bottom of the dispenser. Touch measures 2¾ dia. x 5½ inches (7 dia. x 14 cm) and holds 8 oz. of soap. It looks great in washrooms and by kitchen sinks. Part of a wider collection of bath products, all designed by Alan Wisniewski, Touch'smolded material is low-risk for breakage. Other pieces in the collection include a waste can, toothbrush holder, soap dish, and a toilet brush holder. Items from the collection come in your choice of white, gray and black. For a modern adaptation of an everyday household classic, order the Touch Soap Pump today. About Umbra: A global product design company providing original, modern, casual, functional, and affordable design for the home.
